title: ID0375488-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / N9 160381803] Charger unavailable
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  Plant in not available
Root cause:
AC port and the associated fuses FC5 and FB1 were deactivated on the charger
Solution:
charger is currently available again automatically.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: no
Warranty Status: valid till 9/1/2024

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0375488-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / N9 160381803] Charger unavailable CRM:00579001039
additional_info.body:
Hello team,
Greetings of the day!
We checked and found the following active error flags:
Need to plan site visit and investigate following:
Ensure FC5 and FB1 are not tripped.
else, we need to investigate circuit as per the schematic:
We recommend having spares while site intervention.
From the logs and error flags we can see-
For Contactors QA9-10 coil stuck at ON feedback. Need to check these contactors onsite . If found faulty, need to replace them.
Carry spares contactors with you while being on site.
Also we found that the LOGO is not on the current FW version (Refer logs below).
